water_works.title: Scheduled water supply disruption for pipe connection works
water_works.reason: Pipe diversion and new pipe connection works on the main supply line
areas: Elmina Green (Seksyen U17), including Jalan Cassia U17/75
Parts of Seksyen U16 and U18
water_works.recovery_note: Supply returns in stages: how long depends on each area's distance from the works and the water pressure.
advice: Store enough water before the works start.
Use stored water sparingly until supply is fully back.
water_works.alternative_supply: Water tankers are sent to priority premises such as hospitals and dialysis centres first.
water_works.adapted_from: Air Selangor scheduled disruption for pipe diversion and connection works at Persiaran Selangor, Seksyen 15, Shah Alam (30 March 2021)

power_outage.title: Planned power outage for substation maintenance
power_outage.reason: Scheduled maintenance at the local substation
areas: Elmina Green (Seksyen U17), Jalan Cassia U17/71 to U17/80
power_outage.recovery_note: Power returns when the work finishes; it may come back earlier.
advice: Unplug sensitive appliances such as computers and the TV before it starts.
Expect a short surge when power returns; plug things back in afterwards.
power_outage.adapted_from: Planned outage (hentitugas bernotis) notices from the electricity utility; the minimum notice period for planned outages could not be confirmed from current Energy Commission pages
